packet.on_screen_text:
Tomato pasta
200 g pasta
1 tbsp olive oil
400 g tomatoes
Boil pasta. Simmer sauce. Toss together.
packet.audio_transcript: A quick pasta for dinner tonight.

expected.name: Tomato pasta
expected.description: A simple weeknight pasta with tomatoes and olive oil.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Simmer tomatoes with olive oil, then toss with the pasta.
